claim: One extractor feeds four consumers: chat resend, injection goal_prompt, runtime objective, and CLI show
The core is CommonJS, the shared api package is ESM, and the plugin does not import the core, so the shared extractor needs an explicit seam
The binding section and its anchors sit inside an IF level:phase conditional, so slicing must resolve the conditional rather than strip blindly
A seven-assertion test on the extractor output pins the frontmatter, log, criterion and phase-content boundaries
The slice hash must reach the resend dedup, the brief cache key, and the evaluation site, while the log never contributes to it
